title: Compose profile-enriched Statistics registries
verify: FT-007-AC-003: Lesson Context returns complete Students, Teachers, and Classes rows with permitted profile, C&S, attendance, and payment fields for Admin own-center and Teacher assigned-class scope.

Lesson Context first obtains authorized account IDs from Center & Scheduling, then calls Identity & Access only through Actor Context and consumes the direct Learning Progress and Financial Ledger projection boundaries; Student/Parent, guessed-route, cross-center, and removed-assignment cases return safe denial.
The integration proof verifies composed fields, boundary direction, serializability, and non-mutation without adopting provider formula or owner-internal claims.
evidence_required: FT-007-AC-003 / REQ-014 / REQ-017 RED: profile enrichment occurs before C&S scope, a direct provider table is read, a required registry field/row is absent, an unauthorized role/scope receives data, or composition mutates source facts; GREEN: isolated Lesson Context and route integration tests prove C&S-first account selection, exact Actor Context profile projection, direct attendance/payment query calls, complete serializable rows, denial matrix, and state-before/state-after equality; artifact: .tasks/TASK-076-T3-FT-007-W32/ and .protocols/TASK-076-T3-FT-007-W32/.
purpose: Own the legal cross-slice composition and complete scoped-registry acceptance result for FT-007.
success_outcome: Lesson Context exposes one read-only profile-enriched registry projection assembled only through the four accepted provider boundaries.
anti_goals: Do not read Identity & Access, Center & Scheduling, Learning Progress, or Financial Ledger tables directly.
Do not re-prove provider formulas or provider-internal scope claims.
Do not implement typed sorting or persist a statistics source of truth.
constraints: Lesson Context owns cross-slice statistics composition; routes remain transport/presentation adapters only.
C&S-scoped account IDs precede every profile lookup; providers are called only through the four exact accepted boundaries.
Provider formulas and internal proofs remain owned by TASK-073, TASK-074, and TASK-075.
invariants: Only authorized serializable rows reach the browser.
Statistics reads do not mutate account, class, membership, lesson, attendance, payment, allocation, balance, or audit facts.
Composition never broadens provider scope or reverses a dependency edge.
verification_targets: FT-007-AC-003: complete Students/Teachers/Classes field and role/scope matrix with guessed-route and removed-assignment negatives.
boundary-map.md#actor-context-boundary: profile query receives only C&S-scoped account IDs and returns only fullName/registeredAt.
boundary-map.md#personal-progress-query-boundary and #financial-projection-query-boundary: direct provider calls remain discoverable and provider proof is not inherited.
architecture/system-architecture.md#composition-and-request-data-flow: Lesson Context owns orchestration and routes do not bypass providers.

stop_conditions: Stop if composition requires a new provider edge, source-of-truth owner, or direct provider-table access.
Stop if complete AC-003 proof would require adopting a provider formula claim or changing provider state.
